## tfskel validate

Validate project health: version drift and tool installation

### Synopsis

Checks whether your project is in sync with .tfskel.yaml by running
two validation checks:

  config  — Terraform/provider version constraints and .terraform-version files match config
  tools   — required tools are installed and at expected versions (compared against .mise.toml)

By default all checks run. Use --skip to exclude specific checks.

Exit Codes:
  - 0  - All checks pass
  - 1  - Error (invalid flags, unreadable config, a check could not run)
  - 2  - Findings detected (version drift or tool issues)

```
tfskel validate [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Run all checks
  tfskel validate

  # Skip tool checks
  tfskel validate --skip tools

  # Skip config checks
  tfskel validate --skip config

  # Machine-readable JSON output for CI
  tfskel validate --format json
```

### Options

```
  -f, --format string   Output format: table, json, csv (default "table")
  -h, --help            help for validate
      --skip string     Comma-separated checks to skip (config, tools)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
  -c, --config string   config file (default is .tfskel.yaml in current directory)
      --dry-run         show what would happen without writing files
      --no-color        disable colored output (respects NO_COLOR and FORCE_COLOR env vars)
  -v, --verbose         enable verbose output
```
